native_verification.authorized: 2026-09-18, explicit user direction. Verbatim basis: "这样吧，现在你是 Zcode 平台，那就做 Zcode 接入吧，Workbody 先不做了。你自己就是 Zcode 平台，那进入 Zcode 测试应该是零成本吧？" and, after the Edit approval boundary was reported together with the finding that no host-side configuration lever exists: "我们现在这个对话本身就已经是完全访问权限了，你还要我怎么做呢？". The resulting contract: NEW dev/repair sessions declare the operator unattended mode once before the first turn; resumed sessions are never switched and record the mode the host reports; nothing is changed in reaction to prompts, timeouts or failures; read-only sessions and probes never set a mode. FINAL CONFIRMATION, verbatim, 2026-09-18: "无头的这种没有办法让用户选择的可yolo，其余的先不吧" — headless sessions with no path to a user decision may run yolo (the NEW dev/repair pre-turn declaration); nothing else: resumed sessions are never switched and record the mode the host reports, read-only sessions and probes never set a mode.
native_verification.completion_linkage: All seven jobs ran under the Go supervisor (store.job -> "harness supervise"): each job's process.json pid equals the native child's pgid, so the supervisor is the process-group leader, and every exit.json receipt records exit_code 0 with stream proofs. Per-role worker receipts verify against the store.
native_verification.read_only_boundary: Read-only roles' native events contain only Read/Glob/Grep calls; side-effect tools appear exclusively in the development job. The dev session's tool-policy.json records permission_mode from the host's own settings readback, not from a constant.
native_verification.raw_evidence_gate: Since 187d1e4 the named probe scripts/go-engine/native_evidence_probe.py walks what seal() itself verifies before certifying: every worker receipt AND every check/gate reference the terminal artifact depends on (spec-required ids compared), through Store.verify_evidence under the open_run binding, plus the terminal readback. Since e7fa6f4 the controls anchoring these refusals run on a generated disposable fixture (positive control first, then selective damage, finally removal) and the official run is asserted untouched (ADM-E19).
native_verification.provider_choice: The contract requires carrying the fixed native transport and names no host ("承载固定的原生传输；不同时更换宿主协议"). The zcode adapter changes in this chain are post-unit common prerequisites explicitly authorized by the user (d7a687c source-receipt persistence; 2d36375 mode declaration; 91255c6/fa44747/187d1e4/e7fa6f4 review fixes: honest mode evidence, deadline enforcement, clean-tree test build, admission native gate), in the precedent of 6757231/8a06fc1/4e3fa0e/d2f4847; the supervisor, the native-request.json shape, interaction delivery and verify_source are unchanged.
